package shop.orders

import scala.collection.mutable

/** An order waiting to be packed.
  *
  * Orders with a higher priority are packed first; ties keep arrival order.
  */
final case class Order(id: Long, items: List[String], priority: Int)

/* Scala block comments nest: /* inner { */ still a comment { */
object Queue {

  /** Raw text with a quote and a brace: """{ " """. */
  val Banner: String = """queue { v1 " """

  def empty: Queue = new Queue(mutable.PriorityQueue.empty(ordering))

  private val ordering: Ordering[Order] = Ordering.by[Order, Int](_.priority)
}

class Queue private (pending: mutable.PriorityQueue[Order]) {

  /** Adds an order unless an order with the same id is already waiting. */
  def offer(order: Order): Boolean = {
    val duplicate = pending.exists(_.id == order.id)
    if (!duplicate) {
      pending.enqueue(order)
    }
    !duplicate
  }

  /** Removes and returns the next order to pack. */
  def poll(): Option[Order] = {
    if (pending.isEmpty) {
      None
    } else {
      Some(pending.dequeue())
    }
  }

  def size: Int = pending.size

  def summary(): String = {
    val ids = pending.toList.map(_.id)
    val total = pending.map(_.items.size).sum
    s"${ids.size} orders, $total items, ids=${ids.mkString(",")}"
  }
}

package audit {
  object Log {
    def record(order: Order): String = {
      val line = s"packed ${order.id}"
      println(line)
      line
    }
  }
}
